Indicator 10 measures a specific quality or outcome standard within the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]], evaluated across national, regional, and departmental levels in [[danmark|Danmark]] [^src1]. The data reveals significant regional disparities in the fulfillment rate, with no entity achieving the established development target of 90% [^src1]. 

Among the regions, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] leads the comparison with the highest fulfillment rate at 52% (493 out of 940) [^src1]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] follows closely with 49% (151 out of 311) [^src1]. At the national level, the overall fulfillment rate stands at 37% (968 out of 2,648) [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] trails significantly, recording the lowest regional fulfillment rate at just 14% (23 out of 163) [^src1]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] also performs below the national average at 23% (259 out of 1,110), while [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] matches the national average exactly at 37% (42 out of 114) [^src1]. 

An outlier in the dataset is [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]], which recorded a 0% fulfillment rate, though this is based on a very small sample size of only 10 cases [^src1]. Because every region and the national average fall drastically short of the 90% target, all entities are marked as not meeting the standard ("Nej") in the dataset [^src1]. As this analysis is based on a single dated section from 2024, no longitudinal trends regarding improvement or decline can be established. Comprehensive background data, methodology, and additional indicator breakdowns are documented across the broader annual registry reports [^src2] [^src3] [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner opfyldelsesgraden af Indikator 10 på nationalt, regions- og afdelningsniveau, og viser en stor regional variation fra 14 % i Nordjylland til 52 % i Midtjylland, uden at nogen region når det fastsatte udviklingsmål på 90 %.
